scripts.dev:online: node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @clockwork/server" "npm run dev -w @clockwork/client"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @clockwork/server && npm run build -w @clockwork/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/browser/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:tools
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @clockwork/shared && npm run build -w @clockwork/content && npm run build -w @clockwork/render
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate:content && npm run simulate -- --matches=10
scripts.build:space: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @clockwork/client
